lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: Not while I was there.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: He didn’t? Did he wipe anything down?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: Not that I know of. (shakes head “no”)

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER:
lines.text: Did he do any laundry? Did he wash some clothes?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: I don’t know.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Wn-What about the knife, where is the knife, be honest with me, where’s the knife? It’s OK, we need to get that OK? Help us out, where’s the knife?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: Probably in the drawer.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: In which drawer?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: His knife drawer.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: And where’s that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: In the kitchen.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Is it probably in there, or do you know it’s in there.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: That’s where I think it is.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Why do you think it’s in there?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: Cuz he wouldn’t let that knife go.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Cuz he wouldn’t let the knife go. How do you know that?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: Cuz it was a pretty nice knife.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Did he tell you that? (Brendan nods “yes”)

lines.speaker: WIEGERT:
lines.text: Did he wash it off or anything or wipe it off or what did he do with the knife?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN:
lines.text: He wiped it off.
